Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the organization of the department of social and health services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the organization of the department of social andhealth services; amending RCW 43.20A.090 and 71.24.360; and adding anew section to chapter 43.20A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall organize the regional service deliverysystem around three geographic regions. (a) Region I shall include the following counties: Okanogan,Chelan, Douglas, Kittitas, Yakima, Benton, Grant, Ferry, Lincoln,Adams, Franklin, Stevens, Pend Orielle, Spokane, Whitman, Walla Walla,Columbia, Garfield, and Asotin. (b) Region II shall include the following counties: Klickitat,Skamania, Clark, Cowlitz, Wahkiakum, Pacific, Lewis, Pierce, Thurston,Grays Harbor, Mason, Jefferson, Clallam, and Kitsap. (c) Region III shall include the following counties: King,Snohomish, Skagit, Whatcom, San Juan, and Island. (2) Each departmental administration and division shall reorganize p. 1 HB 2295its delivery system to be consistent with the department's regionalboundaries.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.20A.090 and 1994 sp.s. c 7 s 515 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary shall appoint a deputy secretary, a departmentpersonnel director, and ((such)) no more than three assistantsecretaries ((as shall be needed)) to administer the department. Thedeputy secretary shall have charge and general supervision of thedepartment in the absence or disability of the secretary, and in caseof a vacancy in the office of secretary, shall continue in charge ofthe department until a successor is appointed and qualified, or untilthe governor shall appoint an acting secretary. ((The secretary shallappoint an assistant secretary to administer the juvenilerehabilitation responsibilities required of the department by chapters13.04, 13.40, and 13.50 RCW.)) The officers appointed under thissection, and exempt from the provisions of the state civil service law((by the terms of RCW 41.06.076)), shall be paid salaries to be fixedby the governor in accordance with the procedure established by law forthe fixing of salaries for officers exempt from the operation of thestate civil service law.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 71.24.360 and 2005 c 504 s 805 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department may establish new regional support networkboundaries in any part of the state where more than one network choosesnot to respond to, or is unable to substantially meet the requirementsof, the request for qualifications under section 4, chapter 503, Lawsof 2005 or where a regional support network is subject to reprocurementunder section 6, chapter 503, Laws of 2005. The department mayestablish no fewer than ((eight)) three and no more than ((fourteen))six regional support networks under this chapter. ((No entity shall beresponsible for more than three regional support networks.))
